flags.message: Frozen context reports amicus_briefs: 6, but the same-day snapshot shows 13 amicus filings on the docket. The 6 matches exactly the entries reading 'Brief amicus curiae' (singular); the seven 'Brief amici curiae' (plural) entries appear uncounted, so the amicus escalation signal systematically undercounts group briefs. My amicus-increment probability assumes the resolver counts the same way as the freezer; if resolution counts all amicus entries the claim resolves true immediately.
